[
{"name": "item_decay_popularity", "idea": "Exponentially time-decayed transaction count over 28 days (factor 0.85 per day), a smooth momentum score that weights yesterday's sales far more than the fixed 7- and 28-day buyer windows.", "level": "article", "sql": "SELECT article_id, SUM(POWER(0.85, date_diff('day', t_dat, DATE '{A}') - 1)) AS ag_decay_pop28 FROM tx WHERE t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY GROUP BY article_id;"},
{"name": "user_section_graphic_share", "idea": "Normalized 90-day share of the user's rows in the candidate's section and graphical appearance, a style-level affinity between the department and index-group shares and orthogonal to colour and type.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH ut AS (SELECT t.customer_id, a.section_no, a.graphical_appearance_no FROM tx t JOIN users u ON t.customer_id = u.customer_id JOIN articles a ON t.article_id = a.article_id WHERE t.t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY), tot AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ut GROUP BY customer_id), sec AS (SELECT customer_id, section_no, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ut GROUP BY customer_id, section_no), gr AS (SELECT customer_id, graphical_appearance_no, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ut GROUP BY customer_id, graphical_appearance_no), ca AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.article_id, a.section_no, a.graphical_appearance_no FROM cand c JOIN articles a ON c.article_id = a.article_id) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.article_id, COALESCE(sec.n, 0) * 1.0 / tot.n AS ag_section_share90, COALESCE(gr.n, 0) * 1.0 / tot.n AS ag_graphic_share90 FROM ca JOIN tot ON tot.customer_id = ca.customer_id LEFT JOIN sec ON sec.customer_id = ca.customer_id AND sec.section_no = ca.section_no LEFT JOIN gr ON gr.customer_id = ca.customer_id AND gr.graphical_appearance_no = ca.graphical_appearance_no;"},
{"name": "repurchase_price_ratio", "idea": "Ratio of the article's current 14-day mean price to the mean price this user paid for it in the last 90 days, so a markdown on an item the user already bought can trigger a repurchase.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH ip AS (SELECT article_id, AVG(price) AS p FROM tx WHERE t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY article_id), uip AS (SELECT t.customer_id, t.article_id, AVG(t.price) AS p FROM tx t JOIN users u ON t.customer_id = u.customer_id WHERE t.t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY t.customer_id, t.article_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.article_id, ip.p / uip.p AS ag_reprice_ratio FROM cand c JOIN uip ON uip.customer_id = c.customer_id AND uip.article_id = c.article_id JOIN ip ON ip.article_id = c.article_id WHERE uip.p > 0;"},
{"name": "user_purchase_cadence", "idea": "Number of distinct purchase days in 365 days and the mean gap between them, so that together with u_recency the model knows whether a user is due to shop and how much to trust their own history over global items.", "level": "customer", "sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT t.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.t_dat) AS n, MIN(t.t_dat) AS f, MAX(t.t_dat) AS l FROM tx t JOIN users u ON t.customer_id = u.customer_id WHERE t.t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 365 DAY GROUP BY t.customer_id) SELECT customer_id, n AS ag_u_days365, CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN date_diff('day', f, l) * 1.0 / (n - 1) END AS ag_u_gap365 FROM d;"},
{"name": "dept_popularity_share7", "idea": "The article's share of its department's 7-day distinct buyers, a within-category popularity that separates the leader of a small department from a mid-ranked item in a huge one.", "level": "article", "sql": "WITH ib AS (SELECT t.article_id, a.department_no, COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS n FROM tx t JOIN articles a ON t.article_id = a.article_id WHERE t.t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY t.article_id, a.department_no), d AS (SELECT department_no, SUM(n) AS s FROM ib GROUP BY department_no) SELECT ib.article_id, ib.n * 1.0 / d.s AS ag_dept_pop_share7 FROM ib JOIN d ON d.department_no = ib.department_no WHERE d.s > 0;"}
]
